research.title: NCETM — Finding equivalent fractions and simplifying fractions
research.use: Equivalent expressions denote the same number; multiplicative explanation follows the invariant visual proportion. Simplifying is not required here.

research.title: NCETM — Unit fractions: identifying, representing and comparing
